Analyst — Business & Legal

Isha Lagu

Bringing research, analysis and structure to business decisions.

Isha combines her legal studies with research and analysis, helping turn information into clear recommendations, working documents and presentations that support the team’s decisions and assignments.

Emailisha@setuhashi.com

LinkedIn profile ↗ (opens in a new tab)

Experience she brings

Her market research covers markets, industry sectors, business and technology trends, and companies.

Her legal research supports analysis of company and joint-venture set-up options, and the preparation of non-disclosure agreements, contract frameworks and other agreements for appropriate review.

She also contributes to business analysis, project planning, governance support and executive presentations.

Her background

Isha is studying law at the Kirit P. Mehta School of Law, NMIMS, Mumbai. Her work at SetuHashi brings her developing legal knowledge together with practical business research, analysis and document preparation.

Her commitment to SetuHashi

Isha helps the team investigate opportunities, organize findings and prepare the materials needed to move work forward. Her role provides business and legal research support, with qualified specialists responsible for legal advice where required.
